# Independent measured-style witness

The private copy of the line-segment project has one structure with scale zero,
a constant background of six counts, and measured points (x, y, s.u.)
(40, 20, 2), (52, 33, 3), (64, 25, 4). Calculation is therefore six by the
zero-scale physical invariant. Measured band edges are [18,30,21] and [22,36,29];
residual band edges are [12,24,15] and [16,30,23]. No app calculation or presentation
function generates these expected values. A separate native presentation gate covers absent, zero and non-finite s.u. values; the file loader accepts strictly positive numeric s.u. cells.

The Qt actor checks exact complete edges, rendered fill, line/marker/bar presence
and absence, one combobox with short ordered names, its own longest-item width, actual toolbar position/input, all Pattern pages, defaults and settings
restart. Background checks cover every Pattern page and the report figure, its actual
legend sample and the solid structure outlines. The HTML consumer witness executes
the complete report script with an independently authored model and captures its
Plotly trace/legend configuration; it is a consumer test, not a browser screenshot.
